annotations.title: Get a run link for a site

description: Creates a browser run link for a catalog tool that supports website addresses. Opening the link fills in the address and starts that tool, which may fetch the target through the site hosting function and configured proxies. The MCP call itself never fetches or audits the target and returns no audit findings. Accepts public HTTP or HTTPS addresses only; rejects private addresses, internal names, credentials and non-standard ports.

url.description: The public page or site to audit. A bare host name uses HTTPS.

name: get_audit_link
